title: Damping off on nursery beds - Sri Lanka

Header: Damping off on nursery beds - Sri Lanka
Fusarium spp, Pythium spp, Rhizoctonia spp, Sclerotium spp Sinhala: Diya malan kema, Tamil: Naattaluhal

Prevention: Seed bed sterilization, burning paddy husk.
Protect nursery beds during heavy rain using shelters.
Monitoring: Drying of leaf tips and withering of seedlings in isolated patches.
Direct Control: Remove and destroy affected seedlings with soil.
Apply partially burned paddy husk between infected rows.
Restrictions: When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label.
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance.
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB).
Seed treatment - Captan 50% WP (4 g/ Kg of seeds).
Apply fungicide as soil drench to nursery beds.
